preconditions.description: The number of months n must be between 2 and 500,000.
The length of the income list a must be equal to the ceiling of n/2.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each income value in the list a must be between -10^9 and 10^9.
The income x for the last ⌊n/2⌋ months must be between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) if k > 0 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the integer k if it exists, otherwise -1.
For each k consecutive months, the total income must be greater than 0.
